subject: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+

messages.author: 840f9155920fe615
messages.subject: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I try to apply some vegetation index for a 4 band Parrot Sequoia+ (Green (550 BP 40), Red (660 BP 40), Red Edge (735 BP 10) and Near infrared (790 BP 40)) image, but if I try to use Blue=NULL in fieldMask(), I always have the output ` Error in mosaic@layers[[Blue]] `, in my examples below:

PaSe.img.RemSoil<- fieldMask(mosaic = PaSe.euca.img, Red=3, Green=1, Blue=NULL, RedEdge=3, NIR=4, index ="CVI")
[1] "4 layers available"
Error in mosaic@layers[[Blue]] :
  attempt to select less than one element in get1index

or 

 # Removing the soil using index and mask
 PaSe.img.RemSoil<- fieldMask(mosaic = PaSe.euca.img, Red=3, Green=1, Blue=NULL, RedEdge=3, NIR=4, index ="SCI")
[1] "4 layers available"
Error in mosaic@layers[[Blue]] :
  attempt to select less than one element in get1index

If I don't use Blue=NULL the index works, but I'm not sure if the function considering Blue=3  (default) or  Red=3 (my option).

Please, any help with my problem?

Thanks in advance,

Alexandre

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+
parts:
Hi Alexandre,

Thanks for sharing this BUG. I will fix it as soon as I have time.

For now, you can just give any number to the Blue (e.g., Blue=2 or Blue=1) and remove this layer afterwords.

Layers #:

Blue=1 #Extra 
Green=1 
Red=2
RedEdge=3
NIR=4

Removing the extra layer "Blue":

mosaic<-PaSe.img.RemSoil$newMosaic[-c("Blue")]
or
mosaic<- PaSe.img.RemSoil$newMosaic[c("Green","Red","RedEdge","NIR")]

Let me know if that works.

Best,
Filipe

messages.subject: Re: FIELDimageR: Re: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+
parts:
Hi Filipe,

Thanks for the answer, but despite the use of Blue=1, I don't have an additional layer in the output (original 4 layers). Is there something wrong with my example and fieldIndex() was recognised by bands correct name?

# Open Parrot Sequoia  - Green (550 BP 40), Red (660 BP 40), Red Edge (735 BP 10) and Near infrared (790 BP 40) Image
PaSe.euca.img<-stack("D:/Dropbox/Canopy_model_Klabin/PA/parrot_klabin_orto_ABOE9G_22_10_2019_utm.tif")
proj4string(PaSe.euca.img) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=22 +south +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
# Removing the soil using index and mask

PaSe.img.RemSoil <- fieldMask(mosaic = PaSe.euca.img, Green=1, Blue=1, Red=3, RedEdge=3, NIR=4)
names(PaSe.img.RemSoil$newMosaic) <- c('Green', 'Red', 'RedEdge', 'NIR')
PaSe.Indices<- fieldIndex(mosaic = PaSe.img.RemSoil$newMosaic, 
                          index = "SCI")

Best wishes,

Alexandre

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: FIELDimageR: Re: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+
parts:
Hi Alexandre,

I am sorry about my delay. I have been very busy this last month. 

I believe the default position for FIELDimageR output images (or layers names) is always "Red", "Green", "Blue", "RedEdge", and "NIR".

In your case, you do not need to change layers' names as showing on your code. You need only exclude the layer "Blue" and continue working with the other layers. Is that make sense? 

We will work on a way to allow using NULL on the RGB layers. I will let you know...!!!

Let me know if you have any other questions.
All the best,
Filipe
